headline: RSWM Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates — Pursuant to Regulation 30 & 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Board of Directors of the Company at its Meeting held today, i.e., 5th August, 2026 have inter alia…
detail: General Updates — Pursuant to Regulation 30 & 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Board of Directors of the Company at its Meeting held today, i.e., 5th August, 2026 have inter alia approved and taken on record the following:1 Setting up of a Denim Garment facility at approx. project cost of Rs. 186.30 crores in joint venture with NDS9 Private Limited. The Project Cost is proposed to be funded through equity contribution and term loans in the proposed ratio of 30% and 70% respectively, which may vary as per stipulation of the term lenders.2 Incorporation of the joint venture company as a Private Limited Company as LNJ NDS9 Global Private…
